The '''Naplousea system''' was located in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Naplousean]]s.<ref name="RoguePlanet" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naplousea [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-4.<ref name="TEA" />
